description:
Your deals, with their agreed terms

Lists every deal the signed-in account is a party to, across all its linked wallets: offers it made, deals it accepted, and offers waiting for its answer as a registration holder. This is the only list that includes each deal's agreed `terms`, and each row carries `actions` (what the account may do now) and `stage`. `deal_type` and `status` filter it; an unknown value is a 400, not an empty list. `limit`/`offset` page through `total`.

Needs Sign in with Chain Daddy (scope api:read).
name: list_my_deals
title: List my deals
